system.description:
The Iron Crucible of Mournas and the Red Waste pits: no forms, no philosophy, just what works when a crowd is watching and money is on the line.

  • Opening Blow: once per round, when you start a grapple or overbear a creature, you also deal your primary unarmed damage. Holding a grapple deals no further damage on its own.
    • 9th level: a creature you are grappling has Disadvantage on checks to escape.
  • Ring Reader: Advantage on Intimidation checks before or during combat, and on checks to read an opponent's fighting style in the first round.
